scam.likely.text: This looks like a trick. Do not send money. Do not share your PIN.

scam.caution.text: Be careful. Check before you do anything.

scam.check_balance.text: Check your balance with your operator's own code, not with a number from this message.

scam.signal.asks_pin.text: This message asks for your secret code.

scam.signal.prize_fee.text: This message says you won something, but you must pay first.

scam.signal.account_block_threat.text: This message threatens to block your account or SIM card.

scam.signal.link.text: This message has a link. Do not open it.

scam.signal.time_pressure.text: This message pushes you to act very fast.

scam.signal.sender_mismatch.text: It says it is from {sender}, but it does not come from {sender}'s real number.

scam.signal.fake_balance.text: This balance message does not come from your operator.

scam.signal.asks_to_call_number.text: This message asks you to call a number. Use the official number instead.

sender.claimed.text: This message says it is from {sender}.

sender.unknown.text: We do not know who sent this message.

about.electricity_bill.text: It is about your electricity bill.

about.water_bill.text: It is about your water bill.

about.telecom.text: It is about your phone line or airtime.

about.bank.text: It is about your bank account.

about.health.text: It is about your health or a hospital visit.

about.administrative.text: It is about an official paper.

about.legal.text: It is about a legal matter, such as court or police.

about.other.text: We could not tell what this message is about.

action.bring_document.text: You must bring or send a paper.

action.go_to_place.text: You must go to an office or a place.

action.take_medicine.text: Take your medicine as the paper says.

action.nothing.text: You do not need to do anything.

action.unclear.text: We are not sure what you must do. Ask someone you trust.

deadline.none.text: There is no date in this message.

money.none.text: This message does not say an amount of money.

help.none.text: If you are not sure, ask someone you trust.

facts_only.intro.text: We could not understand all of this message. Here is what we found.

ui.show_source.text: Where is this in the message?

ui.privacy.text: Your messages never leave this phone.

ui.not_advice.text: SabiTori explains messages. It does not give advice.
